ei.title: A Universal Language in Global Traditional Games
ei.subject: 세계문화와영어비상

fullPassage: Across the world, unique cultures and traditions shape societies and identities. Yet, in this diversity, traditional games and activities stand as a universal bond that breaks boundaries. These games often highlight the shared aspects of cultures, breaking through languages and cultural barriers. A good example of traditional games is the game of "Tag", a popular playground game enjoyed in numerous countries, including the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, India, South Korea, Japan, Germany, and France. In this game, one player is designated as "It" and tries to tag others. When someone is tagged, the tagger says, "Tag, you're It!" He or she becomes the new "It," continuing the game and taking turns being the chaser. "Jump Rope" is another universally loved game. Two participants swing a jump rope, while others jump over it as the rope rotates. This game is popular in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, China, Japan, South Korea, Thailand, India, Africa, and Europe, showing the global appeal of this simple yet engaging activity. "Marbles" involves throwing small glass marbles on the ground to strike and win your opponents' marbles. This game is loved in countries like the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, and Australia, each region having its own variation of rules and game play. And let's not forget "Hide and Seek", a game enjoyed by children and adults alike. This game is played in various countries such as the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, India, Japan, South Korea, Germany, France, China, Brazil, Mexico, Africa, and Europe. In this game, one person becomes "It," while others become "Hiders" to start the game. The game offers the thrill of finding the "Hiders" and the excitement of a chase. Traditional games may be a powerful tool for connecting people worldwide. Regardless of language and culture, they probably unite individuals and provide a platform for discovering common ground. Moreover, they foster cross-cultural understanding. Though these games may vary slightly in rules and names by region, they bring joy to people around the world and form unique cultural traditions.

questions.passage: Across the world, (A)[common / unique] cultures and traditions shape societies and identities. Yet, in this diversity, traditional games and activities stand as a (B)[universal / limited] bond that breaks boundaries. These games often highlight the (C)[hidden / shared] aspects of cultures, breaking through languages and cultural barriers. A good example of traditional games is the game of "Tag", a popular playground game enjoyed in numerous countries, including the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, India, South Korea, Japan, Germany, and France. In this game, one player is designated as "It" and tries to tag others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① unique(고유한)+universal(보편적인)+shared(공통의): 세계의 '고유한' 문화, 경계를 허무는 '보편적인' 유대, 문화의 '공통된' 측면이라는 문맥에 모두 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ② common(흔한)은 각 사회의 '고유한' 문화라는 문맥과 어울리지 않음
❌ ③ limited(제한된)는 경계를 허무는 '보편적' 유대라는 문맥과 정반대
❌ ④ hidden(숨겨진)은 문화의 '공통된' 측면을 부각한다는 문맥과 반대

questions.passage: "Jump Rope" is another universally (A)[hated / loved] game. Two participants swing a jump rope, while others jump over it as the rope rotates. This game is popular in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, China, Japan, South Korea, Thailand, India, Africa, and Europe, showing the global appeal of this simple yet (B)[engaging / boring] activity. "Marbles" involves throwing small glass marbles on the ground to strike and (C)[lose / win] your opponents' marbles. This game is loved in countries like the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, and Australia, each region having its own variation of rules and game play. And let's not forget "Hide and Seek", a game enjoyed by children and adults alike.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① hated(미움받는)는 '보편적으로 사랑받는' 게임이라는 문맥과 정반대
✅ ② loved(사랑받는)+engaging(흥미로운)+win(따다): 보편적으로 '사랑받는' 줄넘기, 단순하지만 '흥미로운' 활동, 상대의 구슬을 '따다'라는 문맥에 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ③ boring(지루한)은 '흥미로운' 활동이라는 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ lose(잃다)는 상대의 구슬을 '따다(win)'라는 문맥과 반대

questions.passage: Traditional games may be a (A)[weak / powerful] tool for connecting people worldwide. Regardless of language and culture, they probably (B)[unite / divide] individuals and provide a platform for discovering common ground. Moreover, they (C)[hinder / foster] cross-cultural understanding. Though these games may vary slightly in rules and names by region, they bring joy to people around the world and form unique cultural traditions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① weak(약한)은 사람을 잇는 '강력한' 도구라는 문맥과 반대
❌ ② divide(분열시키다)는 개인을 '하나로 묶는다(unite)'는 문맥과 정반대
❌ ③ hinder(방해하다)는 문화 간 이해를 '촉진한다(foster)'는 문맥과 반대
✅ ④ powerful(강력한)+unite(하나로 묶다)+foster(촉진하다): 사람을 잇는 강력한 도구, 개인을 하나로 묶음, 문화 간 이해를 촉진한다는 문맥에 맞음 ← 정답

det.analysis:
✅ ① shape: 문화와 전통이 사회와 정체성을 '형성한다'는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② universal: 경계를 허무는 '보편적인' 유대라는 문맥에 적절
❌ ③ hidden(숨겨진) → shared(공통의): 게임이 문화의 '공통된' 측면을 부각해 언어·문화 장벽을 넘는다는 문맥이므로 shared가 맞음. hidden은 정반대 ← 정답
✅ ④ designated: 한 명이 술래(It)로 '지정된다'는 문맥에 적절

This game is loved in countries like the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, and Australia, each region having its own variation of rules and game play. And let's not forget "Hide and Seek", a game enjoyed by children and adults alike. This game is played in various countries such as the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, India, Japan, South Korea, Germany, France, China, Brazil, Mexico, Africa, and Europe.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② avoided → enjoyed: 여러 나라에서 '즐겨지는' 인기 게임
det.analysis:
✅ ① popular: 여러 나라에서 즐기는 '인기 있는' 놀이터 게임이라는 문맥에 적절
❌ ② avoided(기피되는) → enjoyed(즐겨지는): 인기 있는 게임이 수많은 나라에서 '즐겨진다'가 자연스러움. avoided는 popular와 모순 ← 정답
✅ ③ participants: 두 '참가자'가 줄을 돌린다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ④ involves: 구슬을 던지는 것을 '포함한다(수반한다)'는 문맥에 적절

questions.passage: The game offers the ①<u>thrill</u> of finding the "Hiders" and the excitement of a chase. Traditional games may be a ②<u>powerless</u> tool for connecting people worldwide. Regardless of language and culture, they probably ③<u>unite</u> individuals and provide a platform for discovering common ground. Moreover, they ④<u>foster</u> cross-cultural understanding. Though these games may vary slightly in rules and names by region, they bring joy to people around the world and form unique cultural traditions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① thrill: 숨은 사람을 찾는 '짜릿함'이라는 문맥에 적절
❌ ② powerless(무력한) → powerful(강력한): 전통 게임이 전 세계 사람을 연결하는 '강력한' 도구가 될 수 있다는 문맥이므로 powerful이 맞음. powerless는 정반대 ← 정답
✅ ③ unite: 언어·문화와 상관없이 개인을 '하나로 묶는다'는 문맥에 적절
✅ ④ foster: 문화 간 이해를 '촉진한다'는 문맥에 적절

det.analysis:

det.analysis:

✅ ② many(많은): numerous는 '수많은'이라는 뜻으로 many와 가장 가까움 ← 정답
❌ ③ distant(멀리 떨어진): 거리를 나타내어 무관
❌ ④ recent(최근의): 시간을 나타내어 무관
det.tip: numerous = many = 수많은 (numerous countries: 수많은 나라)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 foster와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① encourage(촉진하다/북돋우다): foster는 '기르다, 촉진하다'라는 뜻으로 encourage와 가장 가까움 ← 정답
❌ ② prevent(막다): 반대 의미

det.tip: foster = encourage = 촉진하다 (foster understanding: 이해를 촉진하다)

det.analysis:

questions.passage:

❌ ③ (A)는 부드럽게 '쓰다듬다'가 아니라 세게 '치다/맞히다'

questions.stem:

"a person who you are competing against in a game, contest, or fight"

det.analysis:

questions.passage: "Jump Rope" is another universally loved game. Two participants swing a jump rope, while others jump over it as the rope __________ (rotate).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: rotate(회전하다) → rotates: 'as the rope ___'에서 주어가 the rope(단수, 3인칭)이고 현재 시제이므로 동사에 -s를 붙여 rotates로 써야 한다. 앞의 다른 동사(swing, jump)는 복수 주어라 원형이지만, 이 절의 주어는 the rope 하나다.
det.tip: 단수 주어(the rope) + 현재 시제 → 동사에 -s: rotates

questions.passage: Traditional games may be a powerful tool for connecting people worldwide. Regardless of language and culture, they probably unite individuals and provide a platform for __________ (discover) common ground.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: discover(발견하다) → discovering: 앞에 전치사 for가 있으므로 전치사의 목적어로 동명사(-ing)를 써야 한다. a platform for discovering(발견하기 위한 발판)이 맞다. 앞 문장의 for connecting도 같은 구조로 힌트가 된다.

questions.passage: Traditional games may be a powerful tool for connecting people worldwide. Regardless of language and culture, they probably unite individuals and provide a platform for discovering __________. Moreover, they foster cross-cultural understanding. Though these games may vary slightly in rules and names by region, they bring joy to people around the world and form unique cultural traditions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① personal space(개인 공간): 사람을 하나로 묶는다는 흐름과 어울리지 않음
❌ ② secret codes(비밀 암호): 문맥과 무관
✅ ③ common ground(공통점): 언어·문화와 상관없이 개인을 묶고 '공통점'을 찾는 장을 마련한다는 문맥에 적절 ← 정답
❌ ④ old habits(오랜 습관): 사람을 잇는 긍정적 흐름과 무관
det.tip: a platform for discovering common ground: 공통점을 찾는 장

questions.passage: In this game, one player is designated as "It" and tries to tag others. When someone is tagged, the tagger says, "Tag, you're It!" He or she becomes the new "It," continuing the game and __________ being the chaser. "Jump Rope" is another universally loved game. Two participants swing a jump rope, while others jump over it as the rope rotates. This game is popular in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, China, Japan, South Korea, Thailand, India, Africa, and Europe, showing the global appeal of this simple yet engaging activity.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① giving up(포기하기): 게임을 이어 간다는 흐름과 반대
❌ ② making noise(소란 피우기): 술래를 맡는 방식과 무관
❌ ③ keeping score(점수 매기기): 태그 게임의 규칙과 무관
✅ ④ taking turns(번갈아 하기): 잡힌 사람이 새 술래가 되어 게임을 이어 가며 술래 역할을 '번갈아 맡는다'는 문맥에 적절 ← 정답
det.tip: taking turns being the chaser: 번갈아 술래(추격자)를 맡다
